title: Await It
goal: fetch_score() builds the future. Something still has to run it.
hints: Calling an async fn runs NOTHING — it returns the future itself.
One .await drives it to the i32. A second .await would try to run the number.
explanation: fetch_score() without .await hands back an inert impl Future<Output = i32> — so the async block yields a future-of-a-future, and get() tries to return it as an i32 (E0308: the compiler literally tells you the value is still wrapped). One .await drives the machine to its 42; a second .await fails because i32 isn't a future (E0277). The executor at the bottom is what every runtime is at heart: a loop that polls until Ready.
